verdict.rationale: Pipedream documents a REST API that can create workflows, manage event sources and handle subscriptions, plus a CLI for deploying and developing sources and SDKs/REST API for Connect, so a substantial programmatic surface exists. Nothing in the evidence claims full UI parity, and some features are described only as UI interactions, such as clicking Send Test Event and debugging errors with AI. missing for 10: explicit documented API/UI parity, API coverage for test-event triggering, error debugging and retry configuration, and independent hands-on corroboration of API completeness.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: Use the REST API to create workflows, manage event sources, handle subscriptions, and more.
Deploy an event source from local or remote code.
Pipedream provides TypeScript, Python, and Java SDKs along with a REST API to interact with the Connect service.
You can also consume events emitted by sources using Pipedream's REST API or a private, real-time SSE stream.
